$Comment: The skeleton every contract on Old Jack's board inherits through Parent. It is Abstract, so it
Season keeps every child out of the draw while Hallow's Eve is off, whatever Requires the child
writes. Listing files each child with the board's contracts. Boards posts a child in the board's
night slots; a contract for the daylight slots, or one drawn more often, writes its own Boards,
which replaces this list whole. Rewards is what every contract on the board pays, through
Rewards.Auto because the board goes away with the event and a Claim would wait a year for it: the
board's pay table, and favor with Old Jack and the Hallowed (the Reputation rewards; Amount is how
much). A child that writes its own Rewards.Auto replaces that list whole. Every shipped contract
does, to add MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row for the skill its work trains, so retuning this list
means retuning theirs too. That row carries its own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate
(always Min 1), which leaves it out on a server without that mod while the plain rows still pay
there; a contract whose every row is gated would pay nothing there, so keep these three.
It carries no Requires and no Objectives: a child that writes its own Requires.Factors drops an
inherited gate, and an inherited step can be re-tuned but never removed.
